displayGeometry: Optional displayRings are simplified by 2 m with topology preservation. rings retain source geometry rounded to 0.01 m, for analytical intersection. Simplification does not improve source accuracy.
coordinates: Local metres: x east, y north. Three.js mapping: [x,elevation,-y]. Origin must be added for projected coordinates.

properties.Objektnavn: Nibe Bredning, Halkær Ådal og Sønderup Ådal

coast.source: OpenStreetMap coastline ways via OSM API
coast.method: Directed coastlines (land on left) polygonized with study window; inland lakes excluded.

natura.note: Copied full marine-context habitat/bird designation geometry from prior verified project audit.

navigation.source: OpenStreetMap contributors; downloaded coastline-context extracts 2 November 2026
navigation.limitations: Mapped routes, not an exhaustive shipping-lane inventory or official navigation chart. Buffers are user-defined analysis exclusions, not statutory clearances.

bathymetry.note: Original depths, not smoothed depths. Display/search spacing is not source accuracy. Missing depths stay null.

limitations: OSM coastline is a mapped coast, not a surveyed tidal shoreline.
Natura avoidance is the design brief; designation alone is not a complete habitat inventory.
No complete eelgrass, reef, infrastructure or seabed navigation clearance is available.
Aalborg and northern mainland are clipped at the study-window boundary.
Depth and land elevations use different vertical datums; no datum conversion has been applied.
